title: Quick Dementia Test
summary: A ten-question entertainment challenge for recall, attention, language and reasoning.

landing.intro:
10 questions. Memory under pressure.
How sharp is yours?

about.body:
This ten-question brain challenge mixes immediate and delayed recall with attention, language, visual memory and simple reasoning. It is designed as an engaging snapshot of performance today, not as a dementia screening tool.

Performance can change with sleep, stress, mood, medication, language, education, eyesight, hearing, device use and simple chance. A score from an online quiz cannot confirm or rule out dementia.

steps: Study each memory cue carefully when it appears.
Choose one answer for every question without outside help.
Reveal your score, then optionally unlock the questions you missed and their correct answers.

about.disclaimer: This quiz is for entertainment and general learning only. It is not a validated cognitive assessment and cannot diagnose dementia or any other condition. If memory or thinking changes are new, worsening or affecting daily life, speak with a qualified healthcare professional.

stage-1.preAdCopy: Your ten answers have been checked. Your quiz score is ready to reveal.

profile-1.title: An Excellent Quiz Result
profile-1.copy: You answered nine or ten questions correctly. That is an excellent result on this entertainment challenge—not a medical finding.

profile-2.title: A Strong Quiz Result
profile-2.copy: You answered eight of the ten questions correctly and reached the quiz target. The optional review shows the two answers you missed.

profile-3.title: A Mixed Quiz Result
profile-3.copy: You answered six or seven questions correctly. Some quiz tasks landed and others did not; this score cannot measure cognitive health.

profile-4.title: A Tougher Round Today
profile-4.copy: You answered four or five questions correctly. Tiredness, distraction, language and familiarity can all affect performance on a short quiz.

profile-5.title: The Challenge Caught You Out
profile-5.copy: You answered fewer than four questions correctly. This quiz score cannot indicate dementia or replace a professional assessment.

score.disclaimer: This entertainment score cannot diagnose or rule out dementia. Seek qualified advice for persistent or worsening concerns.

dementia-q8.question: Puppy is to dog as kitten is to what?
